interpretation.bottleneck: at -ngl 6 with 1-token batches the wall is CPU<->GPU offload sync + cold mmap page-ins of the 21.7GB file, not expert FLOPs; expert FFN op-times overlap (sum of op wall times > decode wall time), so cutting ops does not cut wall time 1:1
interpretation.implication: prefetch/keep-experts-hot (remora observer) is the right lever on this host; compute gating is a dead end here
